an10.96:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā ānando rājagahe viharati tapodārāme.
an10.96:1.2: atha kho āyasmā ānando rattiyā paccūsasamayaṃ paccuṭṭhāya yena tapodā tenupasaṅkami gattāni parisiñcituṃ,
an10.96:1.3: tapode gattāni parisiñcitvā paccuttaritvā ekacīvaro aṭṭhāsi gattāni pubbāpayamāno.
an10.96:1.4: kokanadopi kho paribbājako rattiyā paccūsasamayaṃ paccupaṭṭhāya yena tapodā tenupasaṅkami gattāni parisiñcituṃ.
an10.96:2.1: addasā kho kokanado paribbājako āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ dūratova āgacchantaṃ.
an10.96:4.1: puccheyyāma mayaṃ āyasmantaṃ kiñcideva desaṃ sace āyasmā okāsaṃ karoti pañhassa veyyākaraṇāyāti.
an10.96:5.1: kinnu kho bho ‘sassato loko idameva saccaṃ moghamaññanti’ evaṃ diṭṭhi bhavanti?
an10.96:5.2: na kho ahaṃ āvuso evaṃ diṭṭhi
an10.96:6.1: kimpana bho asassato loko idameva saccaṃ, moghamañña’nti evandiṭṭhi bhavanti?

an10.96:11.7: hoti ca na hoti ca tathāgato parammaraṇā …pe…

an10.96:11.9: evaṃ diṭṭhi bhavanti iti puṭṭho samāno
an10.96:11.11: neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato parammaraṇā, ida meva saccaṃ moghamaññanti vadesi.

an10.96:12.4: yathā kathampanāvuso imassa bhāsitassa attho daṭṭhabboti?
an10.96:13.1: sassato loko, idameva saccaṃ moghamaññanti kho āvuso diṭṭhigatametaṃ.
an10.96:13.2: asassato loko idameva saccaṃ, moghamaññanti kho āvuso diṭṭhigatametaṃ.
an10.96:13.3: antavā loko idameva saccaṃ, moghamaññanti kho āvuso diṭṭhigatametaṃ.

an10.96:14.1: yāvatā āvuso diṭṭhigatā yāvatā diṭṭhiṭṭhānaṃ diṭṭhādhiṭṭhānaṃ diṭṭhi pariyuṭṭhānaṃ diṭṭhisamuṭṭhānaṃ diṭṭhisamugghāto. tamahaṃ jānāmi, tamahaṃ passāmi
an10.96:14.2: tamahaṃ jānanto tamahaṃ passanto kyāhaṃ vakkhāmī
an10.96:15.1: ko nāmo āyasmā? kathañca panāyasmantaṃ sabrahmacārī jānantī ti?
an10.96:15.3: ānandoti ca pana maṃ sabrahmacārī jānantī ti.
